import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialSections
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4AffineDifferentialFrame

/-!
# From section-ring differentials to regular rational differentials

On a nonempty open of an integral scheme, the generic germ maps the Kahler
differentials of its section ring to rational differentials. Factoring through
each local ring proves that its image is regular at every point. This map is
the sectionwise comparison needed for the differential sheaf.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
variable (U : X.left.Opens) [Nonempty U]

local instance sectionAlgebra : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) :=
  (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra

local instance sectionFieldTower : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField :=
  curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U
    ⟨genericPoint X.left, genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X)
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U))⟩

/-- The image of a section-ring differential is regular at every point of
the open, by factorization through the differential module of the local ring. -/
theorem kaehlerSectionMap_mem_lattice
    (_hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (η : Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k]) (x : X.left) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField η ∈
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    X.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U ⟨x, hx⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      X.left.functionField := functionField_isScalarTower X.left U ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) η, ?_⟩
  have hcomp :
      ((KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        X.left.functionField).restrictScalars Γ(X.left, U)).comp
          (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField := by
    ext a
    simp [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X.left, U)
      (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp η

/-- The generic-germ comparison from Kahler differentials of the section ring
to the independently defined regular differential sections. -/
def kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials :
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) → Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k] →ₗ[k]
      regularDifferentialSections X U := fun hU =>
  ((KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField).restrictScalars k).codRestrict
    (regularDifferentialSections X U) (fun η =>
      (mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hU).mpr
        (fun x _ hx => kaehlerSectionMap_mem_lattice X U hU η x hx))

@[simp] theorem kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) (η : Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k]) :
    (kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U hU η : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField η := by
  rfl

/-- On an affine open with torsion-free differentials, the generic-germ
comparison is injective. -/
theorem kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_injective (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [Module.IsTorsionFree Γ(X.left, U) Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k]]
    (hne : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    Function.Injective (kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U hne) := by
  haveI : IsFractionRing Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X.left U hU
  intro η ζ h
  exact differentialMap_injective_of_isFractionRing k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField
    (congrArg Subtype.val h)

omit [Nonempty U] in
/-- Inside any neighborhood of a point of a smooth integral curve there is an
affine neighborhood on which the section-ring comparison is injective. -/
theorem smoothCurve_exists_affine_kaehlerComparison_injective
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] (x : X.left)
    {W : X.left.Opens} (hxW : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ (U : X.left.Opens), IsAffineOpen U ∧ U ≤ W ∧ ∃ hxU : x ∈ U,
      letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
      letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
      Function.Injective (kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U ⟨x, hxU⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hsm⟩ := smoothCurve_exists_standardSmooth_affineOpen X x
  obtain ⟨s, hsW, hxs⟩ := hV.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hxW⟩ hxV
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X.left, V) := hsm.isStandardSmooth.toAlgebra
  let U := X.left.basicOpen s
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxs⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) :=
    (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.left.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext a
    exact (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k
      (homOfLE (X.left.basicOpen_le s)).op a).symm
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away s Γ(X.left, U) := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen s
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.localization_away s
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X.left, U) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.trans k Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U)
  exact ⟨U, hV.basicOpen s, hsW, hxs,
    kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_injective X U (hV.basicOpen s) ⟨x, hxs⟩⟩

end
end Hartshorne
